text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Air Groove and I head out to a
store to
buy some supplies for my office.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
How about you? The elegant
Umamusume over
there! Care to try your
luck?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, we did receive
a raffle
ticket while shopping earlier,
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm not particularly interested in the
rewards...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However... this could be considered a seasonal activity. In which case, it would go against my values not to participate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I suppose we may as well give it a
whirl.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't really need your support for
something
like this, but okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove gives the raffle machine a
powerful
spin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I... won?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Everything I do, I do to the best
of my
abilities, but I didn't actually
expect to win this
one.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A hot spring vacation ticket... Quite the

grandiose prize.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Hold on...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I was the one who spun the lever, but
we were
originally given that raffle
ticket while buying
supplies for the
office...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (So who does this actually belong to?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Who should have the privilege of
redeeming it?)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's nothing. I was just wondering who
the
rightful owner of the prize is.
choice_data_list: 難しい顔してどうかした？

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You can hold onto it for the time being.
I'll tell
you when I determine how we
should use it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove forces the ticket into my
hands,
leaving it in my care.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, well—this does look high quality. I can see why they call it "deluxe."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now the question is, how should we
flavor it?
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've got it. Let's do another round at the
stores.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious? You need the perfect

combination of flavors for a delicacy like
this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I think this would benefit from some
demi-glace
sauce.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
We'll get the highest quality ingredients
and
make a sauce to match our prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we go around the stores once more to
cook up
a sauce fit for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Oh... Not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A number of students were telling me
that they
wished to practice their
cooking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they could use a gift like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's go. Help me carry everything.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove looks satisfied as we haul the
massive
amount of carrots back to the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Not awful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even a single carrot can unlock many
possibilities
in the kitchen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It can be used for a salad, for stir-fry, for
juice...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer—what would you make
with it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove and I talk about our favorite
carrot
dishes as we head back.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: A mere consolation prize...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No matter. Luck-based games result in
more
losers than winners.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That's why in real competitions, we must
rely on
skill and talent, not luck alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Imagine learning that from a pack
of
tissues...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove stares at the pack of tissues,
looking
slightly upset.
